collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page and pricing/limits page (English) around 10:32 Beijing time / 02:32Z on 2026-11-07. RSC payload (modelScope and planScope) and the two model tables on the plan page, the pricing-limits wording and the /pricing page were read as published, and the same three pages captured on 2026-11-06 were compared line by line. One new paid model observed, no free variant observed, plus three same-day observations on other GOAT models and on the shared pool wording recorded for context. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One new paid model observed: 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast' (slug deepseek-v4-1-flash-ultrafast, id deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-ultrafast) in the New models table, vendor DeepSeek, category opensource, blurb 'Accelerated V4.1 Flash', launchedAt 2026-11-06, minPlanName GOAT, 1M context (1048576 tokens), reasoning true, vision true, marked 'not yet scored'. Three-part price $2.40 input / $9.60 output / $0.048 cached read per 1M tokens, no cache-write price listed, and $20 per-model monthly credits on the GOAT plan (RSC budgetUsd 20, no budgetSteps, credits column '$20', the same tier as the other New models rows). The GOAT model counters on the plan page moved 71 -> 72 and 97 -> 98, and the pricing-limits All counter moved 99 -> 100. No free variant observed for this model (no deepseek-v4.1-flash-ultrafast:free). The other previously listed paid GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps, and the shared-pool wording did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no shared-pool change, no other GOAT row changes, no adopted.csv row.
